en: So now that we have a general understanding
of what a VPS is and why it's so popular,
the next step of course is to get access to
one. And there is a plethora of providers
out there.
If you're watching any tech YouTubers, you
will definitely have heard about Hostinger
because to me it feels like they are
sponsoring every single one of those videos
out there on YouTube. But of course there
are many, many alternatives. There, for
example, is DigitalOcean out there,
but we also have big players like AWS or
Microsoft Azure, of course.
AWS, for example, offers many services. Most
of them are not related to a VPS, but they
have their very popular EC2 service, which
stands for Elastic Compute Cloud, and that
is a service that allows you to rent
so-called instances or run so-called
instances,
and an instance is just a VPS. So if you
launch an instance there, you can choose
which operating system you want to have on
there, you can choose an instance type which
configures the hardware configuration or
defines the hardware configuration,
and of course therefore you also will be
paying different prices for different
instance types because you get different
hardware profiles,
and a bunch of other stuff can be configured
here as well.
So if you launch such an instance, you are
launching a VPS in the end.
For this course, however,
I will be using Hetzner, which you also may
have heard about.
It is a German
server provider, but of course you can use
it from anywhere in the entire world. And
what's so nice about Hetzner and why you may
have heard about it is that they are very,
very affordable, stable and legit
nonetheless, but very, very affordable.
And if you create a Hetzner account, you can
create a resource, a server there as well.
And that again is your VPS. Now, if you
wanna follow along with that course, you can
of course use any provider. You already may
have a VPS lying around, but here I will be
using Hetzner. It's just worth noting that
there is a plethora of providers out there
and you can of course use any of them.
